graph.name: Mueller Water Products - Water Intelligence Platform (Acoustic Leak Detection)
graph.categories: IoT, Machine Learning, Batch Processing, Containers
graph.notes: Large-scale IoT network (meters, smart fire hydrants, pressure and water quality devices). Smart hydrants record correlated acoustic signals on the pipe network every day. Files go through API Gateway for authentication and security (strong focus on IoT security) and are persisted in S3. A daily ECS batch processes node pairs to find correlations and persistent correlations (over many days). A SageMaker endpoint assigns a leak probability, and analysts qualify the leaks and mark them for field investigation. Field feedback is used about every 6 weeks to retrain the model. Planned: add flow and pressure data.

nodes.name: Fire Hydrant
nodes.notes: Smart fire hydrant IoT devices. They collect acoustic data measuring noises on the pipe network, recorded daily and correlated across multiple hydrants.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Receives the daily acoustic signal files. Provides the authentication and security layer, which is why devices do not push straight to S3 (heavy focus on IoT security).

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Persists the incoming acoustic signal files.

nodes.name: ECS
nodes.notes: Container microservices running a daily batch process. Each file is processed as a node pair to find correlations and persistent correlations (over many days). Chosen over Lambda because the acoustic algorithms are very processor-intensive.

nodes.name: SageMaker
nodes.notes: ML endpoint that classifies persistent correlations and assigns a leak probability score. Retrained with field feedback about every 6 weeks to reduce false positives.

nodes.name: ANALYST
nodes.notes: Human analyst team. Receives leak scores, reviews the persistent correlation, checks with the water utility for other nearby noise sources, and updates the leak status to 'field investigation required'.

edges.notes: Daily correlated acoustic signal files are pushed through API Gateway.
Authenticated and secured files are pushed to and persisted in S3.
Daily batch process on ECS processes each file as a node pair to find acoustic correlations.
Persistent correlations are sent to the SageMaker ML endpoint for classification and a leak probability.
Leak score (probability) is fed to the human analyst team for further classification and field investigation scheduling.
